name: Let's go Flyfishing
summary:
Let's go Flyfishing is another fishing game for PSX. The differences between this title & other fishing games is that in this one you do mountain fishing.

You start the game arriving on a mountain and start controlling the character when you find a shining spot you can play mini games and when you find fishing spot you can start fishing.

The fishing part is in First person perspective.

The character on the mountain part is in Third person perspective.
